resolution: Re-opened by the fresh-context verifier of the fixes. An adjudicator had renamed `born: 658~` to `died`, resting on the record's prose that he was killed at al-Nahrawan. The page that prose cites (Ibn Hisham, ed. al-Saqqa, 4/139-140) has only the Hunayn episode and says nothing of his death, and 658~ is itself an unsourced value from the date-enrichment pass. The edit was reverted to the baseline. Proposed to the founder: remove the unsourced `born: 658~` from data/person/dhu-al-khuwaysira.yaml.

Re-opened by the fresh-context verifier of the fixes. An adjudicator had retargeted `during_reign` to al-Wathiq Abu Dabbus. The revolt is dated 1264-1266 and Abu Dabbus entered Marrakesh on 21 Muharram 665 (October 1266), so he reigned for at most its last weeks, and nothing the event cites names him. The edit silenced the detector without making the record true, and was reverted. The record's relation to al-Murtada already covers the span. Proposed to the founder: remove `during_reign -> person/abd-al-wahid-ii-almohad` from data/event/mudejar-revolt-1264.yaml.

Re-opened by the fresh-context verifier of the fixes. An adjudicator had retargeted `during_reign` to al-Wathiq Abu Dabbus, who did reign in 1268. Proposed to the founder: retarget to person/al-wathiq-abu-dabus once a source the event cites is read, or remove the edge.

resolution: Not fixed, although the detector is quiet. The correction of the caliph's death date (al-Suyuti, Tarikh al-Khulafa p. 763) is sound and stays. But the event's own cited page (al-Suyuti p. 761) dates the innovation to Sha'ban 791 AH, three years after this caliph died: the event record is misdated and its relation to him is false. Found by the adjudicator and confirmed by the fresh-context verifier. Re-dating needs the event's lead sections and its Urdu file, which this run may not touch. Proposed to the founder: re-date data/event/muezzin-salat-adhan-786.yaml to 791 AH and remove or retarget `during_reign -> person/al-wathiq-umar-cairo`.
